companies.name: Manta Cares
companies.description: Support platform for cancer patients and caregivers
companies.funding_notes: Verified domain mantacares.com; San Francisco-based patient-first cancer navigation platform founded by CEO Samira Daswani. Launched Nov 19, 2025 with an oversubscribed $5.4M seed round. OncoDaily's republished announcement says it was led by Pear VC and Sozo Ventures, while the PRWeb release says it was led by Pear VC. Participants include 1843 Capital and strategic angels such as Dr. Stanley Marks. The PRWeb release text omits the amount, which appears in OncoDaily/FinSMEs. Also a graduate of CancerX, AARP AgeTech Collaborative and PharmStars (no grant amounts found).

companies.name: Matter Intelligence
companies.description: Hyperspectral sensors revealing Earth’s molecular composition from orbit
companies.funding_notes: Verified the domain matter.com: its page title is 'Matter Intelligence' and it describes ultraspectral/hyperspectral sensors. El Segundo, CA-based; founded by ex-NASA JPL engineers Vishnu Sridhar (CEO) and Thomas Chrien plus ex-Caltech scientist Nathan Stein. $12M seed led by Lowercarbon Capital with Toyota Ventures, Pear, Mark Cuban and E2MC, announced on emerging from stealth (~Oct/Nov 2024). SEC Form D shows $35,941,896 in equity sold of a $49.1M offering (first sale Apr 7, 2026, 5 investors). Investors aren't named, and the Form D doesn't label the round. 'Series A' comes from Pear's portfolio page and trackers, not a press release. No announcement with a lead found. The total is the seed plus the Form D amount.

companies.name: Maximum
companies.description: Powerful infrastructure to transform the banking system
companies.funding_notes: Verified domain maximum.com: Maximum Technologies Inc., an AI-native core banking operating system, with press contact press@maximum.com and a newsroom on maximum.com. Miami-based (per its press release), founded by Randy Fernando, who previously founded Vault (sold to Acorns) and Power (sold to Marqeta). It emerged from stealth on Aug 3, 2026 with a $30M seed round led by CRV, with Pear VC (the second-largest check), Restive, Plug and Play Ventures, Anthemis and others. Pear says the round closed about eight months before the announcement (~late 2025); the date used is the announcement date.

companies.name: Melonn
companies.description: E-commerce fulfillment and software platform for Latin American SMBs
companies.funding_notes: Verified domain melonn.com; Bogotá, Colombia-based e-commerce fulfillment and software company for LatAm SMBs (founded Nov 2020; CEO Andrés Gómez), operating in Colombia, Mexico and Chile. $20M Series A pre-empted and led by QED Investors (Feb 2022, ~$100M post-money), which brought total raised to $24M, including an earlier pre-seed from NFX with Pear and others (pre-seed amount not broken out). The input lists Series B, but El Cronista (Oct 16, 2026) reports Melonn is still negotiating a Series B targeted for late 2026 (amount undisclosed), so no completed Series B is recorded.

companies.name: Menta
companies.description: White-label payment infrastructure for B2B companies in Latin America
companies.funding_notes: Verified domain menta.global; Argentina-based B2B embedded payments/finance infrastructure (white-label payments, SmartPOS) founded 2021 by Alejandro Quirno Lavalle, Virginia Folgueiro and Santiago Lorenzo. $6M seed led by Base10 Partners with follow-on from Pear VC, MatterScale Ventures and Gilgamesh Ventures (reported Oct 2022 by LatamList; Gunderson Dettmer client announcement). No later rounds found.

companies.name: Meridian
companies.description: Frontier intelligence for overlooked industries
companies.funding_notes: Verified domain usemeridian.io; New York-based (276 5th Ave) company building AI agents and an operating layer for operations-heavy industries (staffing, supply chain, logistics, manufacturing). The company blog (May 1, 2026) announces 'seed funding' to expand its self-healing agent platform, but discloses no amount, lead or investor names in readable text (investors shown only as logos). No news coverage found. Caveat: seed+ rests solely on the company's own seed announcement, and the amount is unknown. Pear entered at Pre-Seed.

companies.name: Millibatt
companies.description: High-power miniature batteries for wearables and IoT devices
companies.funding_notes: Verified domain millibatt.com: Millibatt, Inc., a Los Angeles maker of millimeter-scale lithium-ion batteries spun out of UCLA (founders Janet Hur, CEO, and Leland Smith). It has since renamed itself Nuvola Technology (nuvola.tech), now focused on SafeCoat spray-on battery separators. YC W17. UCLA CNSI (Apr 2021) says seed funding followed in Sept 2016 and the company hoped to raise a Series A later, but gives no amount, investors or round terms. Trackers cite only ~$120K across small 2017 rounds (Pegasus Tech Ventures, Q Venture Partners). No priced seed or Series A announcement, Form D or SBIR award for Millibatt/Nuvola found. Pear's portfolio lists it at Pre-Seed.
